title: QuadrantTaskBoard 四象限任务看板
description: 基于四象限矩阵（如艾森豪威尔矩阵）的任务看板：点击象限标题上的 +（或象限的空白区域）添加任务，活动任务上的紧凑编辑和删除按钮（React 中位于任务卡片内、名称旁边）可编辑或删除任务，在 + 按钮或任务旁直接弹出的面板用于填写任务名称并选择象限，删除前会就地确认；任务可通过拖放或 Shift + 方向键移动（双击即可编辑）。看板是受控的：通过 points 传入任务，并把 onPointsChange 收到的新列表回传。它还接受 QuadrantChart 的其他属性（坐标轴、象限标题、徽标和颜色、刻度、标签……），内置按钮和面板会跟随应用语言。由 minerva-design 导出，而非 minerva-design/charts。

support.notes: Controlled task board on top of the Taro QuadrantChart (points in, onPointsChange out; every other QuadrantChart prop is forwarded, its chart `labels` excepted): a row of quadrant headers under the chart (badge, quadrant title, count unless showCounts={false}, plus-icon add button), an actions toolbar for the selected task (task name, Edit and Delete text buttons; selection is internal or the controlled selectedIndex), an inline panel opened under the headers or the actions toolbar (a caret points at its opener) with a required name Input (the keyboard confirm key saves) and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid with Cancel / Save (Save disabled until the name is not blank), an inline danger confirmation before a delete, tapping an empty quadrant area to add a task there, drag and drop of the dots and the chart's accessible "move to" actions. Add/edit/move/delete/selection logic and the localized texts (labels overrides) come from the shared minerva-design/charts quadrant task helpers. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Beta: needs device validation. No keyboard moves (Shift + arrow keys) or double-tap to edit: mini-program views take no focus and the chart has no double tap; use the Edit button and the move to actions. The actions toolbar sits under the chart instead of floating on the selected dot, and the quadrant headers are a row under the chart instead of over the quadrants. The add buttons draw the plus icon as an SVG data URI image; Edit and Delete are text buttons. Input aria-label and the accessible point list are read on H5; native hosts expose aria-role/aria-label only where the host supports them. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts of the buttons and panels (localized by default)

props.name: disableScroll
props.description: Keeps the page from scrolling while a finger moves on the chart

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name (tap toggles a series)

props.name: crosshair
props.description: Vertical guide line following the finger

props.name: interaction
props.description: Pinch zoom, pan (drag when zoomed) and double-tap reset; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the plot area, in pixels

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, compact units `k` / `万`, separators, month and weekday names of time axes). Mini-programs have no `<html lang>`: pass the app language

props.name: accessiblePoints
props.description: Renders a visually hidden list of the points for the screen readers: one button per point (its name, quadrant and values; a tap is `onPointClick`) and, with `onPointDrop`, "Move to …" buttons moving it to the neighbouring quadrants (`onPointDrop` with the quadrant center)

events.name: onPointsChange
events.description: Called with the next list of tasks after an add, an edit, a delete, a drag and drop or a "move to" action (controlled: pass them back as `points`)

events.name: onPointClick
events.description: Called with the tapped point and its index

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the touched (or hovered) points change

events.name: onZoom
events.description: Called when the user zooms or pans

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-header-color
vars.description: Text color of the quadrant titles (defaults to --text-color)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-header-background
vars.description: Background of the quadrant headers (defaults to a translucent surface)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-count-background
vars.description: Background of the task count chips (defaults to --surface-muted-color)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-count-color
vars.description: Text color of the task count chips (defaults to --text-secondary-color)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-actions-background
vars.description: Background of the toolbar of the active task (defaults to --surface-elevated-color)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-actions-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the toolbar of the active task (defaults to --radius-md)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-panel-background
vars.description: Background of the inline add / edit / delete panel (defaults to a translucent elevated surface)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-panel-border
vars.description: Border color of the inline panel (defaults to a translucent --border-color)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-panel-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the inline panel (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --quadrant-task-board-panel-width
vars.description: Width of the inline panel (defaults to 288px)

basic.title: 艾森豪威尔看板
basic.description: 紧急任务在左侧（reverseX），重要任务在上方：点击 + 或象限的空白区域添加任务，选中任务后可编辑或删除，拖动任务（或按 Shift + 方向键）即可移到其他象限。示例任务名称会跟随页面语言，重命名后则保持不变。

custom-labels.title: 自定义文案与徽标
custom-labels.description: 按投入和影响排列的产品路线图：labels 重命名了按钮、名称字段和删除确认文案（{name} 代表条目名称），quadrants 为每个标题加上编号徽标，并统计 onPointsChange 带来的每一次修改。

roadmap.aria: 按投入和影响排列的路线图
roadmap.name: 功能名称

QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: 在添加、编辑、删除、拖放或键盘移动任务后调用，参数为新的任务列表（受控：将其作为 points 回传）
QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: 按钮和面板的文案（见 QuadrantTaskLabels）；未提供的项跟随语言设置

QuadrantTaskLabels.add: 每个象限的添加按钮，以及添加面板的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.edit: 活动任务的编辑按钮，以及编辑面板的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.delete: 活动任务的删除按钮，以及删除确认框的标题
QuadrantTaskLabels.deleteConfirm: 删除确认的文案；{name} 会被替换为任务名称
QuadrantTaskLabels.name: 名称字段的标签
QuadrantTaskLabels.save: 添加 / 编辑面板的保存按钮
QuadrantTaskLabels.actions: 活动任务工具栏的无障碍名称

QuadrantConfig.points: 任务 { x, y, label, color, size }：受控列表，通过 onPointsChange 更新
QuadrantConfig.xSplit: 竖直分隔线的 X 值（默认为 xDomain 中点）
QuadrantConfig.ySplit: 水平分隔线的 Y 值（默认为 yDomain 中点）
QuadrantConfig.quadrants: 各象限的标题、徽标和颜色；未设置标题的象限显示本地化的默认标题
QuadrantConfig.axisLabels: 分隔线两端的文字，绘制在绘图区内（如顶部的“重要”）
QuadrantConfig.showTicks: 显示坐标轴的数值刻度；false 时只保留矩阵
QuadrantConfig.reverseX: 反转横轴（如将紧急放在左侧）
QuadrantConfig.showLabels: 在点旁绘制任务名称，跳过重叠项
QuadrantConfig.name: 提示框中任务的名称
QuadrantConfig.draggable: 允许用户把任务拖到其他象限（看板默认开启；设为 false 关闭）
QuadrantConfig.showCounts: 在每个象限标题后显示任务数（看板默认开启；false 隐藏，传入函数 (count, points) 则返回自定义文本）
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndex: 选中任务的索引，用圆环标出（null：无）；默认由看板选中最近一次点击、移动或保存的任务
QuadrantConfig.selectedIndices: 多个选中任务的索引，各自用圆环标出

native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.onPointsChange: 在添加、编辑、删除、拖放任务或执行“移到”无障碍操作后调用，参数为新的任务列表（受控：将其作为 points 回传）
native_QuadrantTaskBoardProps.labels: 按钮和面板的文案（add、edit、delete、deleteConfirm、confirmDelete、name、quadrant、save、cancel、actions）；未提供的项跟随语言设置

cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-color: 象限标题的文字颜色（默认为 --text-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-header-background: 象限标题区的背景（默认为半透明表面色）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-background: 任务计数标签的背景（默认为 --surface-muted-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-count-color: 任务计数标签的文字颜色（默认为 --text-secondary-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-background: 活动任务工具栏的背景（默认为 --surface-elevated-color）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-actions-radius: 活动任务工具栏的圆角（默认为 --radius-md）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-background: 就地添加 / 编辑 / 删除面板的背景（默认为半透明的浮层表面）
cssVars.--quadrant-task-board-panel-border: 面板的边框颜色（默认为半透明的 --border-color）

native.limitations: 在 React Native 中，任务通过拖放或读屏软件的“移到”操作移动：不支持 Shift + 方向键移动，也不支持双击编辑（请使用活动任务的编辑按钮）。按钮图标由 View 绘制，无需依赖 SVG。

basic.title: 艾森豪威尔看板
basic.description: 点按 + 或象限的空白区域添加任务，点按任务显示编辑和删除按钮，把任务拖到其他象限即可移动。示例任务名称会跟随应用语言，重命名后则保持不变。

basic.title: 艾森豪威尔看板
basic.description: points、quadrants 和 axisLabels 作为属性设置，reverse-x、hide-ticks 和 height 作为特性设置；minerva-points-change 监听器把新列表回写到 points。

props.points: 任务 { x, y, label, color, size }；把 minerva-points-change 的 detail 回写即可更新看板（受控）；仅作为属性设置
props.quadrants: 各象限的标题、徽标和颜色（topLeft、topRight、bottomLeft、bottomRight）；仅作为属性设置
props.axisLabels: 分隔线两端的文字，绘制在绘图区内（top、bottom、left、right）；仅作为属性设置
props.xDomain: 横轴的范围（默认 [0, 10]）；仅作为属性设置
props.yDomain: 纵轴的范围（默认 [0, 10]）；仅作为属性设置
props.hideTicks: 隐藏坐标轴的数值刻度（只保留矩阵）
props.hideLabels: 隐藏点旁边的任务名称
props.hideCounts: 隐藏象限标题中的任务数
props.height: 图表高度：像素值或任意 CSS 长度（默认 320）
props.locale: 内置文案、默认象限标题和数字所用的语言（如 "fr"）；默认跟随组件库语言
props.noAccessiblePoints: 不渲染视觉隐藏的任务列表（键盘和读屏访问、Shift + 方向键移动）
props.options: 图表的其他引擎选项（图例、提示框、内边距、调色板……）；仅作为属性设置

events.minerva-points-change: 任务发生变化（添加、编辑、删除、拖放、键盘移动）；detail：{ points }，即要回写到 points 的新列表
events.minerva-point-click: 点击了一个任务（它会成为选中任务）；detail：{ point, index }
events.minerva-point-drag: 正在拖动一个任务（每次移动都会触发）；detail：{ point, index, x, y, quadrant }
events.minerva-hover: 悬停（或键盘聚焦）的任务发生变化；detail：{ x, xLabel, items }，无悬停时为 null
events.minerva-zoom: 用户对图表进行了缩放或平移；detail：{ x, y }（可见范围）
events.minerva-renderer-change: 图表渲染后端已就绪，或在 GPU 丢失后回退；detail：{ renderer }
